changes: v6.1.0 - Muse AI (muse.top) real song generation engine integration: (1) New backend proxy MuseController (/api/muse/*) forwarding to project-api.atmob.com with AuthToken header + buildBaseRequest body fields (packageName, appPlatform, machineId, authToken) — keeps JWT server-side, solves CORS; (2) Reverse-engineered API contract verified via probe script: user/info, song/style, song/fast/config, song/master/config, structure templates, explore gallery (770 public songs), generate (Quick=deepseek/generate, Master=song/generate), task polling (work/tasks/query with song/info fallback); (3) Frontend MuseService calls backend proxy only — VITE_MUSE_API_KEY is a presence flag, never the real token; (4) MusicPage.jsx: added Muse engine to ENGINES selector (Headphones icon, fuchsia gradient), MUSE_STYLE_MAP (internal keys → muse Chinese style names), full generate flow for Quick Mode (DeepSeek thinks lyrics) + Master Mode (user lyrics) with pollUntilDone, MUSE badge in works gallery, lyrics textarea for Master Mode, instrumental checkbox; (5) i18n: 7 new music.muse_* keys (zh+en) seeded into SQLite DB (1457 total, validation passed); (6) Detailed step-by-step logging at every muse.top call for failure排查; (7) Tone.js instant preview while muse.top generates, fallback to preview on error (build #31)

v6.0.0 - V6.0.0 MAJOR: 100% FREE music generation engine - (1) Added FreeMusicController with Edge TTS (free vocals, no API key) reused from zinteligencevideoagent project; (2) Added HuggingFace MusicGen + Bark (Suno open-source) integration for free instrumental/singing; (3) Created backend proxy for Suno.cn API to fix CORS; (4) Added Muse-style AI Thinking Panel showing 5-step composition plan before generation; (5) Multi-engine selector: Free/Auto/Suno.cn/Tone.js; (6) Added lyrics input field + 6 free voice presets (zh/en); (7) ffmpeg-static for audio mixing; (8) edge_tts_helper.py to avoid Windows CLI encoding issues; (9) Comprehensive logging in generation pipeline (build #30)

v5.10.0 - Cross-language vision engine + translation fix + GitHub Pages auto-deploy: (1) Fixed critical translation bug where all non-Chinese users saw raw English keys (removed lang==='zh' early-return in tr() function); (2) Fixed LyricsPage.jsx fallback pattern where t() returning raw key short-circuited || chain (added _safeT/trStyle/trTheme helpers); (3) Added Python YOLOv8n ONNX object detection backend (80 COCO classes via cv2.dnn) running in centralizedhub/vision-venv-314; (4) Server-client fusion: frontend POSTs /api/vision/analyze, backend spawns Python worker, results injected into classifyScene scene priorities; (5) 7 categories of YOLO-derived semantic injection (pet, food, sports, travel, office, home, wildlife) with Chinese imagery/themes/emotions; (6) Comprehensive i18n audit: added 50+ missing style/theme keys to zh.json and en.json (tango, bossa_nova, pet_love, culinary, hustle, road_trip, wild_nature, etc.); (7) GitHub Actions workflow for auto-deploy to GitHub Pages on push; (8) Updated .gitignore to exclude ONNX models, Python venvs, pycache; (9) Web/mobile version sync: Capacitor webDir=dist matches Vite build output (build #29)

v5.9.0 - Comprehensive vision analyzer overhaul with zunicorn agent loop engineering: (1) Added 16 new scene profiles covering food, pets, architecture, flowers, sunrise, beach, mountains, autumn, winter, travel, festive, abstract, cafe, starry night, rainy, vehicle, minimalist, vintage; (2) Implemented zunicorn agent self-validation loop (analyze-generate-validate-refine) that detects quality issues like theme conflicts and bright-image-lonely-theme mismatches then auto-refines; (3) Added structured metadata output: labels, tags, wordings, and detailed songStyle (BPM, key signature, time signature, energy, valence, acousticness); (4) Increased skin-detection grid resolution from 20x15 to 30x22 for better face separation in couple photos; (5) Relaxed skin tone thresholds for diverse skin tones; (6) Removed heartbreak/loneliness defaults from couple and portrait classifications; (7) Added safety guard in classifyScene to skip dark/lonely profiles when people are detected; (8) Added self-validation test suite (13 test cases covering people, landscape, weather, food, and regression scenarios) (build #28)

v5.8.1 - Fixed irrelevant lyrics from photo upload: (1) EasyMode now creates Image element from base64 data URL before analysis, (2) Added semantic subject detection layer - detects people, couples, groups via YCbCr skin tone analysis, (3) Semantic scene classification takes priority over color-based classification, (4) Visual context now includes subject type, person count, selfie detection, (5) createVisualBank boosts vocabulary with couple/portrait/group-specific imagery and actions (build #27)

v5.8.0 - Lyrics style selector UX redesign: 7 balanced category cards with unique emojis + gradients (流行主类/摇滚另类/电子氛围/情感类/古典传统/节奏律动/叙事特殊), each card shows 3-8 styles directly without collapse; added jpop (日流) + blues/cinematic/cantopop/indierock/lofi styles; moved image upload tab to first position with discoverable entry in style tab; MV page fallback to local generateMV() when API fails; web+mobile version sync (build #26)
